etymologies.etymologyHTML:
Inherited from Middle English lymon, from Old French lymon (“citrus”), from Arabic لَيْمُون (laymūn) or Persian لیمون (limon), from Persian لیمو (limu), from Sanskrit निम्बू (nimbū, “lime”), ultimately from Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *limaw or Munda. Likely doublet of lime.

The fandom sense is named after the erotic anime series Cream Lemon.

quote.citation: 1680, T. K., The Kitchin-Phyſician; Or, a Guide for Good-Housewives in Maintaining Their Families in Health.  […] ‎[1], How to take away Warts off the Face or Hands, page 14:
quote.text: The juice of Lemmons killeth Warts, but better the water of the ſame juice, diſtilled through a glaſs.

definitions.definition: A semitropical evergreen tree, Citrus limon, that bears such fruits.
A more or less bright shade of yellow associated with lemon fruits.
(slang) A defective or inadequate item or individual.

quote.citation: 1951, Herman Wouk, chapter 20, in The Caine Mutiny, page 243:
quote.text: “ […] the Navy's supposed to give me a ship that goes, and a captain that fights—— That's what all this muck is for, isn't it?”  “Look, it's an old story by now. We're stuck with a lemon. Misfortune of war. […] ”

definitions.definition: (Cockney rhyming slang, shortened from “lemon flavour”) Favor.
(fandom slang) A piece of fanfiction involving explicit sex.

quote.citation: 1997 April 18, Neko, “[Dominion][FanFic][Lemon] A Typical Night at the Station”, in rec.arts.anime.creative‎[2] (Usenet):
quote.text: I'd really like to know what people think of this and whether I should carry on writing lemons or go and hide under a rock somewhere.

quote.citation: 2000 May 30, Ian Blakeman, “[Eva][FanFic][Lemon] A day at Misatos appartment[sic]”, in rec.arts.anime.creative‎[3] (Usenet):
quote.text: WARNING: This story is a lemon and must be viewed with great care. If you are either under the age of 18, think graphic sex is discussing[sic] or you know what my writing is like you should turn away now.

quote.citation: 2002 November 10, Goku Girl, “[DBZ][FanFic][Yaoi] Saiya-jin no Suto-ri Ichi (part one)”, in rec.arts.anime.creative‎[4] (Usenet):
quote.text: This won't be a lemon simply because I can't see myself writing anything like that.

definitions.definition: (geometry) The surface of revolution of a circular arc of angle less than 180° rotated about the straight line passing through the arc’s two endpoints.
Containing or having the flavour/flavor and/or scent of lemons.
Of the pale yellow colour/color of lemons.
(Cockney rhyming slang, from "lemon tart") Smart; cheeky, vocal.

quote.citation: 2009 October 12, Caitlin Moran, “Why I love paying tax”, in The Times:
quote.text: Obviously Emin is not the first public figure to get lemon over tax increases.
